title: Job Searching Can Wait
description:
Job searching is important... but so is living your life. 

If you've been applying nonstop, here's your reminder that taking a weekend off doesn't mean you've failed. The applications will still be there tomorrow. Go make some memories.

Then come back refreshed. Your career bestie will still be here.
